state.question: A building has 100 floors and threshold F in {0,...,100}. An egg dropped from floor <=F survives, and from floor >F breaks. You have three identical eggs; surviving eggs can be reused, broken ones cannot. Drops may be adaptive. What is the minimum worst-case number of drops to determine F exactly?
state.notation: pi is the circle constant; i is the imaginary unit; ln is natural logarithm; sqrt is the nonnegative square root; c is light speed; hbar is reduced Planck constant. * denotes multiplication and ^ a power.

If you cannot determine the answer, select unsure. Return the typed choice. The candidate descriptions are literal proposed answers, not additional premises.
